head: 53d6f31
target: AGENTS.md sets two new contributor contracts for the shared plugin tree: hook scripts locate the plugin root from their own path (dirname "$0"), never CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from the environment because Droid replaces it with a placeholder in hook processes; and editing hooks/hooks.json changes its Codex trust hash, so a change that edits it must tell Codex users to rerun scripts/codex-trust-hooks.
incidental: README.md: explanations of existing behavior (the three plugin components, install.sh and per-harness install commands, quizgate install opt-in, the session-start hook in fresh clones, org-wide settings.json, the ~/.agents/skills symlink, plugin update commands) - docs of a design the author already owned

AGENTS.md step rules: run scripts/selftest after skills/ or hooks/ changes, run claude plugin validate after manifest changes, bump version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json so installs pick up the change - steps, incidental even though stated as rules
AGENTS.md and README rerun-steps for scripts/codex-trust-hooks after an update that touches hooks/hooks.json - steps, incidental even though stated as rules
AGENTS.md's one-plugin-tree statement: documents the existing layout, context for the target rules
CLAUDE.md: symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude Code reads the same rules - plumbing

questions.prompt: Why must the hook scripts locate the plugin root with dirname "$0" instead of reading CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from the environment?

options.label: Inside hook processes Droid replaces CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT with a placeholder, so the invoked script's own path is the one route to the plugin root that works in all three harnesses
Claude Code never sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in hook processes, so even there the scripts need their own path
Codex refuses to run a hook that reads CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, because its trust hash covers the hook's environment

key_points: Droid sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT to a placeholder inside hook processes, so reading it from the environment would resolve a bogus plugin root in Droid
The invoked script's own path (dirname "$0") works in every harness, which keeps one copy of each hook script serving Claude Code, Droid, and Codex

questions.prompt: A new PreToolUse hook script is added under hooks/ and wired into hooks/hooks.json. Which of these must the change that adds it account for? Pick all that hold.

options.label: The new script must find the plugin root from its own path, never from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in the environment
The single-tree layout means the hook must be added once per harness, since each reads its own hooks file
Editing hooks/hooks.json changes its Codex trust hash, so the change must tell Codex users to rerun scripts/codex-trust-hooks
Once the version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json is bumped, Codex runs the new hook with no further steps

key_points: The new script must locate the plugin root via dirname "$0" and not CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from the environment, or it breaks in Droid where that variable is a placeholder
Wiring the hook into hooks/hooks.json edits that file, which changes its Codex trust hash, so the change must tell Codex users to rerun scripts/codex-trust-hooks or Codex skips the untrusted hook
